conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: The curriculum support team establishes and monitors the district curriculum aligned to the state standards, the Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS), in all curricular areas. Campus administrators will collaborate with the appropriate director/program director on any campus-based decisions concerning district scope and sequence or assessments. All lesson plans will follow the district lesson plan template.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: Lesson plans are to be completed in the curriculum management system submitted according to the campus plan weekly, and saved. Lesson plans will be approved by the curriculum assistant and principal. Each building principal or assistant principal will create a system to make lesson plans available for substitutes in the event of unexpected teacher illness.
